$comment: The auto-learn loop. A defect is NOT fixed until a check exists that would have caught it. Every entry names its verifying check; audit-system.py fails when an entry names a check that does not exist, and warns when `check` is null. memory/corrections.md was the prose ancestor of this file and is gitignored, so nothing it recorded survived a clone — which is why this lives in a tracked path and is machine-checked. Entries are append-only: a correction whose check was later removed is a regression, not a tidy-up.
rule: found -> fixed -> CHECKED. Two of three is not done.

corrections.defect: index-system.py's token counter returned on the first $value and never descended, so every token nested inside another token was invisible. The repo reported 666 tokens while holding 712.
corrections.found_by: writing an independent walker for an unrelated question
corrections.verifies: counts primitives and aliases by descending into hybrid nodes; a divergence from the index count surfaces

corrections.defect: 27 nodes in semantic-dark carried a $value AND child tokens — invalid DTCG. Would have broken the Figma variable import ADR-001 depends on.
corrections.verifies: refuses to write while any node is both a token and a group; audit-contracts.py reports hybrids independently

corrections.defect: Gate B blocked EVERY legitimate component. The index stores kebab-case, JSX writes PascalCase, and they were compared raw. A gate that blocks correct work teaches people to route around it.
corrections.found_by: validation/test-gates.py, on its first ever run
corrections.verifies: case 'INDEXED vendor component' — <Button /> must be ALLOWED

corrections.defect: No gate covered design-system/foundations/ at all. The audit printed 'skipped 0 · PASS' on runs that never opened brand.md.
corrections.found_by: grepping the hooks for the path after an agent flagged an unusual citation form
corrections.verifies: check 5b walks foundations/*.md — citations resolve, no scratch/ dependencies. Negative-tested with planted faults.

corrections.defect: Adapter #1 keyed the component index on DIRECTORY names, not public exports. 13 entries were not importable (Carbon ships Card as preview__Card); ~230 real exports were missing, including Table — which matched our L1 'table' and PASSED Gate B while resolving in code to Carbon's.
corrections.class: generator never checked against its own output
corrections.found_by: external research contradicting a claim I had made

corrections.defect: 13 tokens_used references in the L1 primitives pointed at nothing. Hand-authored at Stage 0 against a token layer that did not exist yet, never re-checked when it landed.
corrections.verifies: check 4c — every tokens_used entry must resolve to a real token path or glob

corrections.defect: flatten-dark-tokens.py 'proved' light and dark were identical by normalising BOTH sides before comparing, then writing only one. It compared a corrected copy against the real thing.
corrections.verifies: compares dark against light AS IT IS ON DISK; refuses unless the rebuilt key set is identical

corrections.defect: brand_defined was a boolean and could not express 'written but not approved'. It reported true while brand.md sat unapproved at Gate A, advertising the brand as settled.
corrections.class: state flattened to fewer values than it has
corrections.found_by: noticing the flag flip when brand.md was first written
corrections.verifies: _brand_status() reads three states from brand.md's own Status line; brand_defined is derived from it

corrections.defect: Five literals sat above the primitive layer in tokens.json, inherited from Carbon's own upstream files, breaking the alias-only contract.
corrections.class: contract asserted in prose, unchecked in code
corrections.verifies: find_literal_leaks — recurses through composite $value dicts and arrays, so a single literal anywhere fails

corrections.defect: Documentation drifted: 'no design system exists yet' (x3 files), 'Nine ADRs' when there were 17, five enforcement layers when there were six, three validation scripts documented of twelve.
corrections.verifies: check 5e — a declared list (validation/declared-counts.json) of specific prose sentences, each matched by a regex and compared against a value independently re-derived from the repo (ADR files, agent roster, component-index.json, artifacts/_types.json, tokens.json, CLAUDE.md's own enforcement table). A mismatch is an error naming the file, the stated number and the actual number; a claim whose wording changed is a separate warning rather than silently dropping off. Negative-tested 2026-08-31: a planted '787 tokens' in CLAUDE.md was caught and named exactly, then cleared on revert. Declared list only — a count not in declared-counts.json is uncovered, not verified (see V-012)
corrections.note: CLOSED as a check, but re-running it on 2026-08-31 found the same class of defect had already recurred and gone unnoticed: README.md still said 17 ADRs (repo has 19), AGENTS.md still said 12 workers (repo has 13, since system-keeper was added), and CLAUDE.md's L1-of-total artifact-type count still said 34 of 40 (repo has 35 of 41). Reported, not silently fixed — prose correction is outside system-keeper's job; these four findings are now live ERRORs in audit-system.py until a human or the owning agent corrects the documents.

corrections.defect: 1316 lines of reasoning behind ADR-018 and the token layer sat in scratch/, which is gitignored. A clean would have left ADRs asserting conclusions with no visible working.
corrections.class: durable decision resting on disposable evidence
corrections.found_by: the user asking that decisions be memorialised
corrections.note: STILL UNCHECKED. Nothing verifies that a tracked document's cited evidence is itself tracked. The foundations check does this for design-system/foundations/ only — decisions/ is uncovered.

corrections.defect: Gate B read a MENTION of a citation as a citation, and blocked an ADR for quoting CLAUDE.md's own example ID.
corrections.class: parser cannot distinguish use from mention
corrections.found_by: the gate blocking a legitimate write
corrections.verifies: cases 'citation MENTIONED, not made' (must allow) and 'citation MADE and unresolved still blocks' (must block) — the pair matters: stripping mentions must not blind the gate to real claims

corrections.defect: brand-director and token-keeper had agent definitions but no node on the system map. Both are cross-phase, so they never landed in a phase lane and the diagram silently showed 12 of 14 agents.
corrections.class: a representation of the system omitting part of it
corrections.found_by: asking whether the map's nodes correspond to things that actually exist
corrections.verifies: check 5d — every .claude/agents/*.md must appear as a node, and every agent node must have a definition (a ghost node is a blocker)

corrections.defect: Three artifact types — a11y-audit, design-critique, heuristic-review — were owned by agents holding tools:[Read]. The owners physically could not produce the types assigned to them, so those types were uncreatable. audit-system.py check 2 verified the owner EXISTED; it never asked whether the owner could write.
corrections.found_by: asking which agent could produce an artifact to verify V-016
corrections.verifies: check 2 now requires a type's owner to hold Write; check 3 requires finder agents to hold Write and to hold neither Edit nor Bash

corrections.defect: A finding artifact could record 'found: 0' with no denominator, making an audit that never ran byte-identical to one that ran clean. Zero findings is a legitimate pass; zero findings out of zero checks is a run that did not happen.
corrections.class: absence of evidence recorded as evidence of absence
corrections.found_by: designing against the question 'what if it goes blank'
corrections.verifies: check 5a — a finder-owned artifact must carry findings.findings_by matching the type owner, an integer findings.checked > 0, and an integer findings.found. Negative-tested with a planted zero-denominator audit.
